remarks: THIS IS THE ONE YOU HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR. A Dinyar Wadia masterpiece. Reimagined 1930 Tudor estate with all the allure and convenience of new construction. Arrive through a stone pillared drive into the world of yesteryear with grace & style like no other. The perfect trifecta- *prime private location on park-like property with sweeping lawns and all the amenities *superior quality steel and concrete construction & *architectural provenance. Interior highlights include the addition of a spacious family room with limestone fireplace and coffered ceiling, dining room with gigantic picture window overlooking the incredible grounds, an office with a plethora of built-ins, owners bedroom suite with dual baths and dressing rooms, mudroom with bath and built-ins and finished lower level. The gourmet kitchen is an entertainer's dream with 2 islands, breakfast room, top-of-the-line appliances, custom hood, plentiful limestone countertops and pantry storage. Wadia utilized the good bones of the original Tudor, preserved & restored existing beauty & grandeur and breathed new life into the structure by seamlessly adding modern spaces in 2010. Green features include geothermal heating, cooling & pool heat and spray foam insulation. Exterior amenities include a covered back porch, pool, pool house with vaulted ceiling, kitchen & bath, outdoor brick fireplace, tennis court, gardens, specimen trees, professional landscaping & outdoor lighting, 4-car garage and storage shed or 5th garage.
